stories.title: U.S. Army to detonate unstable explosives in Iowa Friday, potentially sending toxic lead dust into NW Illinois
stories.summary: The Army plans to detonate 68 barrels of degraded lead azide in Middletown, Iowa, at noon Friday. Forecasts show a dust plume moving north and staying west of the Chicago area, but sampling will determine where lead lands.

stories.title: Dozen McDonald's locations in Metro Detroit helping families in need
stories.summary: Twelve McDonald's locations are getting into the holiday spirit by giving out free turkeys on Thursday.

stories.title: Royal Oak Market Art Fair kicks off Thursday
stories.summary: The 11th annual Art Fair in Royal Oak is underway on Thursday and Friday.

stories.title: Fiona the hippo has died, Cincinnati Zoo says
stories.summary: Fiona the hippo, who survived being born prematurely and rose to global fame, has died, the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden announced Thursday.

stories.title: Batman's Batpod among $13.2 million in movie props up for auction
stories.summary: Batman's Batpod is among $13.2 million in movie props up for auction in December at Propstore's Winter Entertainment Memorabilia Live Auction.

stories.title: Commerce Township teacher saves choking student: "It was my job to help her"
stories.summary: An elementary school student in Commerce Township, Michigan, is safe after the heroic actions of her teacher saved her life.

stories.title: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her sons
stories.summary: Susan Smith, who rolled her car into a South Carolina lake 32 years ago, killing her two sons who were still strapped in their car seats, was denied parole for a second time Thursday.

stories.title: Michigan receiver Andrew Marsh facing a misdemeanor indecent exposure charge
stories.summary: Michigan receiver Andrew Marsh is facing a misdemeanor charge of indecent exposure after a food delivery driver alleged that he exposed himself to her after she dropped off his order.

stories.title: 4 children, 2 adults, pets receiving medical care after Shelby Township house fire
stories.summary: Six people and the family pets are all receiving medical care after a house fire early Thursday in Macomb County.
